fusions.name: Browsing Kick
fusions.desc: A quick kick that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 10% of the damage dealt. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Scatter
fusions.desc: Bucks out, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. You restore 6 health and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Graze
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds and 8 health at once. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nibbling on the Run
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You gain 6% dodge chance.
